modifications: Bounded managed host requests onto the real SlideApp/Session; no second document store.
Hosted policy disables standalone import, file, clipboard, URL and network paths.
Explicit managed start after verified WASM init; automatic standalone main disabled only for zoen-host.
Canonical persistence/export is owned by Zoen tools; loading code grants no device/network capability.
Managed owner-queue freeze fences manual editing across final snapshot/commit/retirement.
Managed UI receives finite host safe areas/exact close corner through the owner queue; existing Export delegates PDF/PPTX intent to native accepted-head sharing before generating browser bytes.
Hosted narrow layouts reuse the slide sorter, inspector controls and ribbon groups with full-width canvas/touch actions; authenticated host theme changes egui tokens only.
Hosted panels use a real safe-content child Ui over a full-viewport backdrop; raw safe-area metadata alone does not position egui panels.
Real upstream egui Harness validates compact safe bounds, theme, inspector/Notes draft rotation and command reuse; compact status excludes its separator from44pt hit space.
Hosted editor drains a removed speaker-notes draft through the original slide.notes command before document observation; failed writes retain the exact draft for retry.
Retained speaker-notes drafts bind to document UID and immutable SlideId, resolving current order only at commit; missing slides remain retryable without writing to replacements.
Host Freeze drains the UI-local Notes body through the existing command before frozen ACK; policy or origin failures keep the draft and refuse teardown instead of reporting clean.
Phone-height hosted landscape windows reuse compact toolbar/status/ribbon/inspector, keeping the safe canvas full width and retaining live choices/drafts across actual wide-panel transitions.
Actual title/Notes taps assert final egui PlatformOutput.ime before typed input and real document commit; these engine assertions do not claim native DOM/WK keyboard acceptance.
distributionStatus: Not advertised: final managed release, MCP adapter and iOS runtime proof required.
